name: Basic
desc: Demonstrates the basic usage of Mingling with a simple `greet` subcommand that takes a name and prints a greeting.

name: Argument Parse
desc: Shows how to use Mingling's `parser` feature with a `Picker` to extract and validate typed arguments from the command line.

name: Argument Picker
desc: Demonstrates how to use Mingling's `picker` feature and `Picker` to extract typed arguments from the command line.

name: Async Support
desc: Shows how to drive an async runtime with Mingling using the `async` feature, enabling `async fn` in `#[chain]` with tokio.

name: Clap Binding
desc: Demonstrates how to bind a `clap::Parser` derive struct to Mingling using `#[dispatcher_clap]` for advanced argument parsing.

name: Pathfinder + Dispatch Tree
desc: Demonstrates combining the `pathf` and `dispatch_tree` features. Types are defined in submodules and automatically resolved. Requires `dispatch_tree` in both `[dependencies]` and `[build-dependencies]`.

name: Command Macro
desc: Introduced how to use the `#[command]` macro to generate commands with minimal boilerplate

name: Completion
desc: Demonstrates how to implement dynamic shell completion with `#[completion]` and generate scripts for bash, zsh, fish, and pwsh.

name: Custom Pickable
desc: Shows how to implement the `Pickable` trait on custom types for seamless extraction from CLI arguments via Picker.

name: Dispatch Tree
desc: Introduces the `dispatch_tree` feature that converts the subcommand list into a compile-time prefix trie for O(n) command lookup.

name: Enum Tag
desc: Shows how to derive `EnumTag` on enums for parsing variants from CLI strings with renames and descriptions.

name: Error Handling
desc: Demonstrates how to define custom error types with `pack!` and route them to dedicated `#[renderer]` functions for user-friendly output.

name: Exitcode
desc: Shows how to set custom exit codes using `ExitCodeSetup` and the `finish` hook to signal success or failure to the shell.

name: Help
desc: Shows how to use the `#[help]` attribute to provide custom per-command help text that activates when the user passes `--help`.

name: Hook
desc: Demonstrates how to use Mingling's `ProgramHook` system to observe and debug every stage of the execution pipeline.

name: Implicit Dispatcher
desc: Shows the abbreviated `dispatcher!("cmd.path")` syntax from `extras` that auto-derives struct names from the command path.

name: Lazy Resources
desc: Demonstrates how to use `LazyRes<T>` for lazily initialized resources that only allocate when first accessed.

name: Outside Type
desc: Demonstrates how to use the `group!()` macro to convert an external type into a type recognizable by Mingling

name: Pack an Error
desc: Demonstrates how to use the `pack_err!` macro to define error types with automatic `name` field (snake_case at compile time) and optional `info` field. Also shows `--json` serialization when `structural_renderer` is enabled.

name: Panic Unwind
desc: Shows how to catch panics during program execution and display friendly error messages instead of a raw panic trace.

name: Module Pathfinder
desc: Demonstrates the `pathf` feature, which automatically resolves type module paths at build time. Types can be defined in submodules without explicit `use` in the main module.

name: REPL Basic
desc: Demonstrates how to build an interactive REPL shell with Mingling using `exec_repl()`, custom prompts, and built-in setups.

name: Resources
desc: Shows how to share global state across commands using `with_resource()` and inject `&T` or `&mut T` into chain and renderer functions.

name: Setup
desc: Demonstrates how to build a custom `ProgramSetup` with `#[program_setup]` for modular configuration of program behaviour.

name: structural renderer
desc: Demonstrates how to render structured output in JSON or YAML using `StructuralRendererSetup` and the `structural_renderer` feature.

name: Unit Test
desc: Shows how to write unit tests for Chain and Renderer functions using the `entry!` macro and assertion helpers.

name: Todo List
desc: This is a complete example project that demonstrates how to develop a todo list application using Mingling
